value.residual: The mandatory static gate inventories every promoted handwritten Lean and F* source, requires exact Lean warning-as-error commands, rejects Lean sorry/admit/axiom/local warning disablement and F* source or command admission flags, requires an explicit trusted-assumption manifest, and scans every declared hax-generated Norn_ir.fst evidence artifact after extraction. A post-run gate also binds every cited test selector to an exact observed passing Rust or Bun test name in the owning command log. These are finite source/governance and execution-attestation checks, not proofs of the Lean/F*/SMT/toolchain implementation, translator, operating system, hardware, or host. Public scope excludes the former engine/provider implementation and its evidence; no correspondence is claimed for that omitted code.
